body:
### Summary

We're getting recurrent errors of that kind, on several developers machines + Windows Jenkins nodes, when we use uv from scratch to create a new venv

```
> uv venv
Using CPython 3.14.6
Creating virtual environment at: .venv
error: Failed to install: colorlog-6.12.0-py3-none-any.whl (colorlog==6.12.0)
  Caused by: RECORD file is invalid
  Caused by: The process cannot access the file because another process has locked a portion of the file. (os error 33)
```

After several tries, we can get it to work, but sometimes we need up to 4/5 retries before success.
We do have an Antivirus software running on all our configurations, that we can't suspend (due to an immutable configuration done by our IS department).

### Platform

Windows 11 x86_64

### Version

0.11.32

### Python version

Python 3.14.6
title: "RECORD file is invalid" recurrent error on Windows
